description:
The RSB scheme stands for the Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana. 

It was launched by the Government of India to provide health insurance coverage to the economically weaker sections of society. 

The main objective of the scheme is to provide financial protection against health-related expenses. 

The scheme offers health insurance coverage of up to INR 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. 

Beneficiaries include families living below the poverty line and those in the unorganized sector. 

The application process involves filling out a form available at designated centers or online through the official website. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare along with state governments. 

The coverage is available for a wide range of medical procedures and treatments. 

The scheme also includes pre-existing diseases from the first day of coverage. 

Beneficiaries can avail services at empaneled hospitals across the country. 

The scheme aims to reduce out-of-pocket expenditure on health care for vulnerable populations. 

The timeline for the coverage is annual and can be renewed each year. 

The scheme is part of the larger effort to achieve universal health coverage in India.
